abilities.name: Smoke Screen

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.desc: Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.

abilities.name: Blade Storm
abilities.desc: Project fierce Shadow Clones of Ash upon groups of distant enemies. Join the fray using Teleport. The Shadow Clones can be upgraded with mods.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/AshPrime.name: Ash Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/AshPrime.desc: Distraction and subterfuge become lethal weapons with Ash Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/Brawler.name: Atlas
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/Brawler.desc: Enemies tremble before the brawler with fists as hard as stone. Atlas deals high damage. Command terrestrial elements that form the foundation of any battlefield.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/Brawler.passive: Becomes immune to Knockdown effects while on the ground.

abilities.name: Landslide
abilities.desc: Bash enemies with an explosive sliding punch, repeat up to three times for a combo attack. Each hit in the three-punch combo increases the radius of the attack. Energy cost is reduced with each hit of Landslide. Install mods on the Landslide Fists to boost stats.

abilities.name: Tectonics
abilities.desc: Summon a Bulwark rock-wall, activate again to send the rocks crashing toward the enemy. Bulwarks attacked by enemies release an area-of-effect Slash powered by the Health it has lost.

abilities.name: Petrify
abilities.desc: Atlas' hardened gaze will fossilize foes increasing the damage they take, heal Rumblers, and create Petrified Bulwarks. When shattered, petrified enemies drop healing Rubble for Atlas.

abilities.name: Rumblers
abilities.desc: Summon two elemental stone brawlers to the melee. Summoning petrifies enemies in close proximity to Atlas. When finished, Rumblers collapse into a pile of healing Rubble.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/AtlasPrime.name: Atlas Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/AtlasPrime.desc: In bygone ages, mountains were said to house warriors. In this age, the mountain has become the warrior.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/AtlasPrime.passive: Becomes immune to Knockdown effects while on the ground.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/Banshee.name: Banshee
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/Banshee.desc: Banshee's call heralds death. She maintains crowd control and identifies enemy weak points with sonic attacks. Few can hold their position when struck by her force.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/Banshee.passive: Banshee pierces the ears of enemies within a Xm radius when casting Abilities, applying max Puncture Status Effect. Additionally, Banshee's weapon noise is hushed.

abilities.name: Sonic Boom
abilities.desc: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate attackers and reduce their Armor.

abilities.name: Sonar
abilities.desc: Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak points to everyone in your squad.

abilities.name: Silence
abilities.desc: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies, limits their perception and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks, and renders them unable to activate their abilities.

abilities.name: Sound Quake
abilities.desc: Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground in a targeted area.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/BansheePrime.name: Banshee Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/BansheePrime.desc: Banshee Prime assails her foes by manipulating sonic forces to deadly effect. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/Pacifist.name: Baruuk
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/Pacifist.desc: Beware the fury of the truly patient. Baruuk boasts survivability and crowd control. Pushed beyond his restraint, he unleashes the storm within.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/Pacifist.passive: Each projectile dodged, each enemy lulled or disarmed, erodes Baruuk's restraint and fuels the storm within. As Baruuk's restraint is diminished he becomes up to X% more resistant to damage.

abilities.name: Elude
abilities.desc: Dodge all incoming projectiles, but only while not attacking. Use again to deactivate this ability.

abilities.name: Lull
abilities.desc: A calming wave slows enemies until they fall into a slumber. Enemies woken by damage will be confused and disoriented. Short-term amnesia means all waking enemies forget anything that happened before the lull.

abilities.name: Desolate Hands
abilities.desc: Summon a bevy of orbiting daggers to seek out enemy guns, destroying them with a small explosion. Combine with Elude to double the range.

abilities.name: Serene Storm
abilities.desc: With his Restraint eroded, Baruuk commands the Desert Wind to deliver powerful radial strikes with his fists and feet. Each moment commanding the storm restores his Restraint.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/BaruukPrime.name: Baruuk Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/BaruukPrime.desc: Doomed are the fools who attack the peace and exhaust the restraint of this reluctant warrior.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/BaruukPrime.passive: Each projectile dodged, each enemy lulled or disarmed, erodes Baruuk's restraint and fuels the storm within. As Baruuk's restraint is diminished he becomes up to X% more resistant to damage.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/Sentient.name: Caliban
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/Sentient.desc: The heir of twin kingdoms ascends. Biological and Sentient life meet in Caliban. An adept monarch, he offers crowd control and survivability. His creator had more than one world in mind.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/Sentient.passive: Allies within Affinity range gain up to X% resistance to the types of damage they are currently taking.

abilities.name: Razor Gyre
abilities.desc: Dash forward in a spinning vortex of death. Struck enemies are inflicted with Tau Status Effect, making them more vulnerable to all other status effects. For each enemy hit, recover a portion of the energy cost, as well as health and shields. Enemies lifted by Sentient Wrath take increased damage.

abilities.name: Sentient Wrath
abilities.desc: Smash the ground sending out a radial wave of destruction. Those not killed by the initial blast are helplessly raised into the air, where they take amplified damage for a short time.

abilities.name: Lethal Progeny
abilities.desc: Cycle through Sentient unit types, then summon them to Caliban's side. Conculysts focus on raw melee damage. Ortholysts specialize in ranged attacks and inflict Tau Status Effect. Summulysts summon their own Choralysts and provide shield protection for the squad.

abilities.name: Fusion Strike
abilities.desc: Converge three streams of raw energy upon a single point, causing a massive explosion. The streams strip armor and shields, and each enemy struck detonates on stream convergence. Summoned Conculysts can wield their own mini Fusion Strikes.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/CalibanPrime.name: Caliban Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/CalibanPrime.desc: Forged in celebration of the all-too-brief peace between the Orokin and Sentients, Caliban Prime is a true collaborative masterpiece. The heir of twin kingdoms arises in royal gold.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/Dragon.name: Chroma
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/Dragon.desc: Unleash the draconic. Chroma employs Heat, Electricity, Toxin, and Cold to deal high damage while maintaining survivability. Soar with winged fury.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/Dragon.passive: Wings sprout for an additional jump and bullet jump.

abilities.name: Spectral Scream
abilities.desc: Exhale a deep breath of elemental destruction. Tap to cycle through elements, hold to cast. The chosen element applies to all of Chroma's abilities.

abilities.name: Elemental Ward
abilities.desc: Depending on Chroma's elemental alignment, an offensive area-of-effect is created. Chroma and its nearby allies are imbued with defensive energy.

abilities.name: Vex Armor
abilities.desc: Chroma fortifies squad Armor when his Shields are damaged or he kills an enemy with a melee weapon. He increases squad Weapon Damage when he loses Health or he kills an enemy with a ranged weapon, double the effect on weak point kills.

abilities.name: Effigy
abilities.desc: Chroma turns his pelt into a massive sentry that strengthens nearby allies and engulfs enemies in elemental attacks.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/ChromaPrime.name: Chroma Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/ChromaPrime.desc: Bind the elements and unleash untold destruction with Chroma Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/ChromaPrime.passive: Wings sprout for an additional jump and bullet jump.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Geode.name: Citrine
/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Geode.desc: Gaze upon the Crystal Bastion. Citrine's crystalline might supports allies on the battlefield. Combat only enhances her fractal beauty.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Geode.passive: Citrine grants nearby allies X health regeneration per second. Pick up a Health Orb to increase regeneration by X, up to a maximum of X.

abilities.name: Fractured Blast
abilities.desc: Slash and stagger enemies with a crystal blast that inflicts Slash Status. Enemies afflicted with this Status Effect have an increased chance of dropping Health and Energy Orbs.

abilities.name: Preserving Shell
abilities.desc: Citrine guards herself and nearby allies with a crystalline shell that gradually decays. Kills and assists increase the defensive power of the shell.

abilities.name: Prismatic Gem
abilities.desc: Deploy a gem that shoots prismatic beams. The gem targets enemies that are taking weapon damage from Citrine and her allies. Its beams inflict Heat, Cold, Toxin, and Electricity Status Effects. Status Chance and Status Duration increase for nearby allies.

abilities.name: Crystallize
abilities.desc: Citrine summons crystal fractals. The fractals rush forward, seeking enemies. Enemies touched by the fractals are paralyzed by crystalline growths. Hit the growths to deal Critical Damage.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/Frumentar.name: Cyte-09
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/Frumentar.desc: Move like a shadow, strike with force. The Orokin created a Warframe that marries damage and stealth to eliminate sensitive problems, but he disappeared in the chaos of their demise. All that remains is a batch name: Cyte-09.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/Frumentar.passive: Weak Point Kills increase Cyte-09's Weak Point Critical Chance by X% up to X% for the duration of the current mission.

abilities.name: Seek
abilities.desc: Plant an antenna that projects a forward wave scan. Detected enemies take increased Weak Point Damage, and become visible through walls. Weapons gain Punch through.

abilities.name: Resupply
abilities.desc:
Throw two Elemental Ammo Packs that instantly refill the active weapon’s magazine, while granting the weapon an additional instance of the selected Elemental Damage and Status Effect. Reload clears the effect. Sniper Rifles gain extra damage.

Hold the ability to select the Elemental Damage type.

abilities.name: Evade
abilities.desc: Jump backwards and become invisible for a short duration. Killing enemies on their Weak Points extends the duration and heals Cyte-09.

abilities.name: Neutralize
abilities.desc: Summon the Neutralizer, Cyte-09’s exalted Sniper Rifle. Bullets ricochet off Weak Points to seek out other nearby Weak Points. Alt fire lobs a Cold grenade that completely freezes enemies.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Dagath/Dagath.name: Dagath
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dagath/Dagath.desc: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Dagath's malice deals high damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dagath/Dagath.passive: There is a X% chance that Energy and Health Orbs will be X% more effective on Dagath.

abilities.name: Wyrd Scythes
abilities.desc: Wyrd Scythes surround Dagath and seek out nearby enemies. Those struck are slowed and suffer Viral Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. The scythes also spread Doom and extend its duration.

abilities.name: Doom
abilities.desc: Condemn nearby enemies to their doom. A portion of the damage Dagath deals is revisited upon them by a Wyrd Scythe. They also suffer Viral Damage.

abilities.name: Grave Spirit
abilities.desc: Supercharge Dagath's weapons with extra Critical Damage. The effects are doubled on Doomed enemies. Escape fatal blows by briefly assuming a spectral form.

abilities.name: Rakhali's Cavalry
abilities.desc: Phantom Kaithes charge forth, inflicting Viral Damage upon all in their path. Their attack strips the defenses of Doomed enemies.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Pagemaster/Pagemaster.name: Dante
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pagemaster/Pagemaster.desc: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pagemaster/Pagemaster.passive: Noctua scans targets, recording information for your Codex. Status Chance increases by X% on fully scanned targets.

abilities.name: Noctua
abilities.desc: Open Noctua, Dante's Exalted Tome, and unleash a tale of woe upon his enemies.

abilities.name: Light Verse
abilities.desc: Dante's vitalizing composition grants him and his allies Overguard and restores their Health.

abilities.name: Dark Verse
abilities.desc: Dante's composition draws blood from nearby enemies, inflicting Slash Damage upon them.

abilities.name: Final Verse
abilities.desc:
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse.

TRIUMPH: Two Light Verses cast in succession invigorate allies with a buff that increases Health and grants Overguard. Kills and assists briefly regenerate Overguard.Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse.
TRAGEDY: Two Dark Verses cast in succession attack enemies. Damage Over Time from Slash, Heat and Toxin Status Effects accumulates in a single blast.Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse.
WORDWARDEN: A Light Verse followed by a Dark Verse supports allies with copies of Noctua. Noctua copies synchronize their attacks with their designated ally's attacks.Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse.
PAGEFLIGHT: A Dark Verse followed by a Light Verse summons Paragrimms that swoop at enemies, making them vulnerable to Status Chance and Status Damage, as well as drawing enemy attacks away from allies.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Ember.name: Ember
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Ember.desc: Harness the power of fire. Ember’s heat deals high damage. She keeps a cool head when the battle is hot.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Ember.passive: Receive X% Ability Strength for every enemy within Affinity Range affected by Heat.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.desc: Release a fiery projectile that ignites enemies on contact.

abilities.name: Immolation
abilities.desc: Protect Ember with flame armor that burns stronger over time, consuming energy once its meter is at full strength. Cast again to extinguish the flame.

abilities.name: Fire Blast
abilities.desc: Slam the ground to create a wave of incinerating plasma that knocks back enemies and strips their armor.

abilities.name: Inferno
abilities.desc: Command a flaming comet to crash down in front of Ember, engulfing enemies with a fire that can spread through their ranks.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/EmberPrime.name: Ember Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/EmberPrime.desc: Ember Prime offers the same potential for wanton destruction as Ember but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.

/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/YinYang.desc: Equinox rises from the edge of day and night. Her Day form offers offensive support while her Night form offers defensive support. She thrives between realms.
/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/YinYang.passive: X% of Health Orbs are converted into Energy, and X% of Energy Orbs are converted into Health.

abilities.name: Metamorphosis
abilities.desc: Switch forms, temporarily gaining bonus Shields and Armor in Night-Form, or bonus Damage and Speed in Day-Form.

abilities.name: Rest & Rage
abilities.desc: In Night-Form, targets are put to sleep. In Day-Form, targets become more vulnerable to damage.

abilities.name: Pacify & Provoke
abilities.desc: In Night-Form, reduces damage inflicted by nearby enemies. In Day-Form, increases Ability Strength of nearby allies.

abilities.name: Mend & Maim
abilities.desc: In Night-Form, allies' Shields are replenished with each nearby enemy killed. In Day-Form, enemies are inflicted with Slash Status Effect. Deactivate while in Night-Form to restore Health and Shields for Equinox and allies. Deactivate while in Day-Form to cast a wave of slashing force.

abilities.desc: Drop through an inky frame and emerge invulnerable at the aimed location in a splash of ink that inflicts Inkblot on nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Shadowgraph
abilities.desc:
Bring shadowgraphs from Follie's sketchbook to life as items that can be used for tactical advantage. Shadowgraphs splash Inkblot onto nearby enemies when created.

HOLD to open the Shadowgraph gear wheel.

abilities.name: Self Portrait
abilities.desc: Draw an ink effigy to absorb the damage dealt to Follie and allies. Below, a pool of ink spreads Inkblot. Kill enemies inside the pool to grow Follie's effigy and its ink puddle.

abilities.name: Plein Air
abilities.desc: Tie nearby enemies to floating balloons that douse them with Inkblot. Pop the balloons to send them crashing to the ground, splashing damage on nearby enemies.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/Frost.name: Frost
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/Frost.desc: When Frost steps onto the battlefield, enemies experience a chill. Frost's attacks control crowds, protect objectives, and increase survivability. Wield the biting cold.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/Frost.passive: Cold Status Effects from Frost's Abilities last X% longer. Frost gains X Armor for each enemy afflicted with Cold within Affinity Range.

abilities.name: Freeze
abilities.desc: A frigid energy blast that freezes targets in their tracks.

abilities.name: Ice Wave
abilities.desc: Sends a wave of razor sharp, crystalized ice toward an enemy, dealing heavy damage.

abilities.name: Snow Globe
abilities.desc: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.

abilities.name: Avalanche
abilities.desc: Summons a treacherous landslide of ice that instantly freezes and shatters all enemies in its radius.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/FrostPrime.name: Frost Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/FrostPrime.desc: Frost Prime has the same chilling abilities as Frost but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/FrostPrime.passive: Cold Status Effects from Frost's Abilities last X% longer. Frost gains X Armor for each enemy afflicted with Cold within Affinity Range.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/Glass.name: Gara
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/Glass.desc: Enemies are made fragile by Gara’s deadly touch. Gara’s vitric abilities provide her and her allies with survivability and deal high damage. Shatter the foe.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/Glass.passive: A chance to create a radial blind lasting Xs when Gara casts Abilities.

abilities.name: Shattered Lash
abilities.desc: Lash out with stream of shattered glass, or hold for an arcing strike. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Shattered Lash.

abilities.name: Splinter Storm
abilities.desc: Gara's armor splinters into a maelstrom of shattered glass. Allies who contact the cloud are fortified against damage.

abilities.name: Spectrorage
abilities.desc: Trap enemies in a carousel of mirrors, forcing them to attack visions of their true selves. Destroyed mirrors damage their attackers, as does the collapse of the carousel.

abilities.name: Mass Vitrify
abilities.desc: Create an expanding ring of molten glass that slowly crystallizes enemies who enter. When the expansion is complete, the ring hardens to block weapons fire. The ring draws extra strength from the health and shields of crystallized enemies. Use Shattered Lash to smash the ring and send razor-sharp glass flying.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/GaraPrime.desc: Continue the legend of the glass-armored warrior Gara. Dominate the battlefield with the power and purity of crystal.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/Garuda.desc: Death’s crimson maiden sharpens her talons. Garuda weaponizes the blood of her foes to deal high damage. Sanguine beauty complements her deadly power.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/Garuda.passive:
Garuda's damage temporarily increases with each enemy she kills, to a maximum of X%. 
Slashes with her talons if no melee weapon is equipped.

abilities.name: Dread Mirror
abilities.desc: Rip the life force from an enemy and use it as a shield that captures damage, this kills significantly weakened enemies instantly. Charge to channel the captured damage into an explosive projectile.

abilities.name: Blood Altar
abilities.desc: Impale an enemy on an altar of talons and siphon health for Garuda and her allies.

abilities.name: Bloodletting
abilities.desc: Garuda sacrifices her health to generate energy and clear Status Effects.

abilities.name: Seeking Talons
abilities.desc: Charge to expand the targeting area, release to send Garuda's talons careening toward each target in area. Surviving enemies are prone to Slash Status.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/GarudaPrime.name: Garuda Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/GarudaPrime.desc: White, gold and deepest scarlet, the queen of gore in full regalia.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/Runner.name: Gauss
/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/Runner.desc: Take charge with the Saint of Altra. Gauss is fast, deals high damage, and has strong survivability. Movement charges his powerful battery, so never stop moving.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/Runner.passive: Moving generates an electrical current that fills Gauss' battery. Shields recharge up to X% faster while the Recharge Delay is up to X% shorter, based on the battery level.

abilities.name: Mach Rush
abilities.desc: Burst into a hyper-sprint bowling over enemies and charging the battery. Crashing into solid objects generates a powerful shockwave. Hold to rush continuously.

abilities.name: Kinetic Plating
abilities.desc: Generate armor plating that converts a portion of absorbed Kinetic Damage (Physical, Heat, Cold, and Blast) into Energy. Also protects Gauss from being staggered or knocked down. Damage Resistance is relative to the battery level.

abilities.name: Thermal Sunder
abilities.desc: Siphon kinetic energy from the area, charging the battery and inflicting Cold Status on nearby enemies. Hold reverses the process, draining the battery and inflicting Heat Status on nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Redline
abilities.desc: Push Gauss' battery beyond the redline, supercharging his Abilities and setting Fire Rate, Attack Speed, Reload Speed, and Casting Speed into overdrive. When past the redline, bolts of arcing electricity dance periodically from Gauss, exploding en masse when the ability is deactivated.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/GaussPrime.name: Gauss Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/GaussPrime.desc: Quicksilver takes form. Gauss Prime brooks no talk of defeat.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/Devourer.name: Grendel
/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/Devourer.desc: Grendel sees every battlefield as a smorgasbord. His insatiable appetite rewards him with high survivability. Enemies will be eaten. And regurgitated.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/Devourer.passive: Each enemy consumed grants X bonus armor.

abilities.name: Feast
abilities.desc: Swallow enemies whole and store them in Grendel's gut. Hold to vomit out stored enemies, covering them in toxic bile.

abilities.name: Nourish
abilities.desc: Regenerate health as Grendel absorbs nourishment from enemies in his gut. While he digests, enemies that attack or are attacked by Grendel suffer Viral Damage and energy sources provide more energy. These buffs extend to squad mates.

abilities.name: Pulverize
abilities.desc: Grendel curls into a ball. He heals over time as he rolls, knocking over anyone in his path. Jumping slams Grendel into the ground and generates a damaging shockwave.

abilities.name: Regurgitate
abilities.desc: Violently puke out a bile soaked enemy from Grendel's gut, turning the consumed into a toxic projectile that does bonus damage based on the enemy's Max Health. Nearby enemies are slowed and have their armor dissolved by the bile.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/GrendelPrime.name: Grendel Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/GrendelPrime.desc: Primal. Insatiable. Grendel Prime devours all who oppose him.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/GrendelPrime.passive: Each enemy consumed grants X bonus armor.

abilities.name: Cathode Grace

Overshield capacity doubled.
Start missions at maximum energy.

abilities.name: Penance

abilities.name: Thurible

abilities.name: Covenant

/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/IronFrame.desc: Strength is Hildryn’s virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/IronFrame.passive: Hildryn's full Shield Gate is high. After her Shields are depleted, she is invulnerable to damage up to 3.5s.

abilities.name: Balefire
abilities.desc: Charge and launch devastating bolts of electricity.

abilities.name: Pillage

abilities.name: Haven

abilities.name: Aegis Storm

abilities.name: Sandstorm

abilities.name: Scarab Shell

abilities.name: Prowl

/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/Choir.desc: Become enraptured by the song of devastation. Through her, the Jade Light can be a force of destruction or a source of support.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/Choir.passive: Jade's profound understanding of the relationship between life and death grants her two Aura Mod Slots. Some of her Abilities apply Judgments, increasing enemy damage vulnerability by X% for Xs.

abilities.name: Light's Judgment
abilities.desc: Create a well of light that heals allies and hurts enemies. Those who enter the well will be highlighted by Judgments.

abilities.name: Symphony Of Mercy
abilities.desc: Cycle through three songs that strengthen allies. Power of The Seven increases Ability Strength. Deathbringer increases Weapon Damage. Spirit of Resilience increases Shield Effectiveness. Extend the duration of each song by killing enemies surrounded by Judgments.

abilities.name: Ophanim Eyes
abilities.desc: Jade summons an accusatory gaze that slows nearby enemies and dissolves their Shields and Armor. When the gaze falls upon allies, they can be revived from a distance.

abilities.name: Glory On High
abilities.desc: Soar with destructive power. Use alternate-fire to detonate Judgments, causing an explosion of Jade Light. Enemies inside the Light's Judgment radius empower the explosion.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Khora.name: Khora
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Khora.desc: Khora is red in whip and claw. She works together with her Kavat companion, Venari, to deal high damage and provide crowd control. Two bodies, one will.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Khora.passive: The ferocious kavat, Venari, fights by Khora's side and provides her with a X% speed boost while active. If killed, Venari will reappear after Xs.

abilities.name: Whipclaw
abilities.desc: Send enemies reeling with a deafening whipcrack. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Whipclaw.

abilities.name: Ensnare
abilities.desc: Bind a hapless target in living metal, entangling others who stray too close. Whipclaw will refresh the trap allowing it to capture more enemies.

abilities.name: Venari
abilities.desc: Command Venari to focus on a target. Hold to cycle between Attack, Protect, and Heal postures. If Venari is killed, use this ability to revive her instantly.

abilities.name: Strangledome
abilities.desc: Weave a dome of living chain that ensnares and strangles any enemy within, and any foolish enough to approach. Foes outside the trap will try to hasten their comrade's deaths by shooting them. Crack Whipclaw on the dome to further damage any trapped enemies.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Koumei/Koumei.desc: Test your luck with the dice-maiden. Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Koumei/Koumei.passive: Every X seconds, one of Koumei's weapons will inflict random Status Effects for X seconds.

abilities.name: Kumihimo
abilities.desc:
Weave the threads of destiny. Enemies who touch the threads suffer a random Elemental Status Effect.

A roll of triple sixes creates threads that inflict one of every Elemental Status Effect.

abilities.name: Omikuji
abilities.desc:
Koumei glimpses a favorable future and the precise steps needed to reach it. Complete the challenge to earn a Decree. Unlucky rolls add a debuff, but you can hold the ability to reject the Omikuji.

A roll of triple sixes grants a Decree without a challenge.

abilities.name: Omamori
abilities.desc:
Surround yourself with Omamori Charms, each with a chance to have enemy attacks heal you instead of damage you. The number of charms is determined by Koumei's dice roll.

A roll of triple sixes grants invulnerability for the duration of your Omamori Charms.

abilities.name: Bunraku
abilities.desc:
Wield your foe’s fate threads like the strings of marionettes. Koumei’s dice determine how many Status Effects foes in front of Koumei will suffer.

A roll of triple sixes causes further Status Effects over time and extends Bunraku to enemies behind Koumei.

/Lotus/Powersuits/PaxDuviricus/PaxDuviri.name: Kullervo
/Lotus/Powersuits/PaxDuviricus/PaxDuviri.desc: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.
/Lotus/Powersuits/PaxDuviricus/PaxDuviri.passive: Kullervo boasts +X% Heavy Attack Efficiency and +X% Heavy Attack Wind Up Speed on all melee weapons.

abilities.name: Wrathful Advance
abilities.desc:
(TAP) Kullervo charges a Heavy Attack, then teleports to his target and strikes. His rage-filled focus temporarily increases his Melee Critical Chance.
(HOLD) Teleport to any marked location.

abilities.name: Recompense
abilities.desc: Kullervo surrounds himself with daggers. Each dagger that strikes an enemy restores his health, but each dagger that misses an enemy strikes Kullervo, dealing a bit of damage. When Kullervo has max Health, he receives Overguard from struck enemies.

abilities.name: Collective Curse
abilities.desc: Kullervo sends forth a curse that binds enemies. When a cursed enemy takes damage from him, every other cursed enemy also suffers a portion of that damage.

abilities.name: Storm Of Ukko
abilities.desc: The Void answers Kullervo's invocation with a storm of daggers that rain down upon his enemies.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/Alchemist.name: Lavos
/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/Alchemist.desc: The serpents of Lavos encourage him as he transmutes the battlefield. He uses Toxin, Cold, Electricity, and Heat to deal elemental damage. Harness the power of the dark alchemist.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/Alchemist.passive:
Energy and Universal Orbs give Lavos status immunity for Xs.

Hold any ability to imbue the next cast with additional Elemental Damage and Status.

abilities.name: Ophidian Bite
abilities.desc:
Lash out with a toxic serpentine strike, consuming the target to heal Lavos.

Hold to imbue all abilities with Toxin.

abilities.name: Vial Rush
abilities.desc:
Dash forward, crashing through enemies and leaving an icy trail of broken vials.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with Cold.

abilities.name: Transmutation Probe
abilities.desc:
Launch a probe that converts Health and Energy Orbs into Universal Orbs that provide both, and ammo pickups into Universal Ammo Pickups. The probe shocks enemies in close proximity. Each electrocuted foe reduces other ability cooldowns by 1.5s.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with Electricity.

abilities.name: Catalyze
abilities.desc:
Catalyst Probes erupt from Lavos and douse combatants in a fiery gel. Damage is doubled for each element afflicting an enemy.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with Heat.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/Magician.desc: Master the rift between shadow and substance. Limbo disrupts time-space to provide crowd control. He is at home where others struggle with what is real.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/Magician.passive: Dodge to enter and exit the Rift. Entering leaves behind a small Rift portal lasting Xs. Energy slowly recharges in the Rift, and each enemy killed in there also gives X Energy.

abilities.name: Banish
abilities.desc: Casts a wave of Rift energy that damages hostiles while pushing enemies and allies out of Limbo's current plane of existence.

abilities.name: Stasis
abilities.desc: Freezes Rift-bound enemies. While active, enemy projectiles are arrested in mid-air, resuming its trajectory when stasis ends.

abilities.name: Rift Surge
abilities.desc: Surges nearby Rift-bound enemies with Rift energy. When killed the Rift Surge is transferred to a nearby enemy outside the rift. Surged enemies that leave the Rift perform a radial Banish.

abilities.name: Cataclysm
abilities.desc: A violent blast of Void energy tears open a pocket of rift plane which can sustain itself for a short period before collapsing in another lethal blast.

abilities.name: Radial Disarm

/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/Mag.desc: Take down your enemies with magnetic force. Mag alters magnetic fields to provide crowd control and strip enemy defenses. Few can resist her attraction or her repulsion.

abilities.name: Pull

abilities.name: Divine Spears

abilities.desc: Create a well of life on an enemy who will absorb Status Effect damage intended for nearby allies. Allies gain additional Health when they attack the target. If allies die, enemies in the well of life die in their stead.

abilities.name: Energy Vampire
abilities.desc: Allies will gain energy over time when enemies are marked with Energy Vampire.

abilities.name: Link
abilities.desc: Any damage taken while Link is active will be channeled to a nearby enemy.

abilities.name: Blessing
abilities.desc: Restore the health and shields of allies within Affinity Range while reducing the damage they take from enemies.

/Lotus/Powersuits/DemonFrame/DemonFrame.name: Uriel
/Lotus/Powersuits/DemonFrame/DemonFrame.desc: To fight as the Heretic of Xata is to have demons at your back. Uriel incinerates foes with searing brimstone, and commands three fiendish summons to do his devil’s work.
/Lotus/Powersuits/DemonFrame/DemonFrame.passive:
Uriel commands, empowers, and protects three unique demons.

CATENACH: Snares and slows enemies chaining them together. Damage dealt to any target in the chain is inflicted on all snared enemies. (Unlocks with Infernalis)
GULPHAGOR : Latches onto foes dealing damage over time. If killed, a circle of pain is spawned. (Unlocks with Remedium)
VYTHELAS: Inscribes demonic runes upon fallen foes that add Fire Rate and Heat Damage when collected. (Unlocks with Demonium)

abilities.name: Infernalis
abilities.desc:
Manifest an aura of flames inflicting Heat Damage and Status Effect on nearby enemies.

Tap Dodge while airborne to take flight as a flaming meteor of destruction.

abilities.name: Remedium
abilities.desc: Uriel heals himself and his demons. If his demons are dead, they are resurrected.

abilities.name: Demonium
abilities.desc: Uriel rips out the souls of his demons, draining their health, and sends them in search of new victims. Souls explode on contact with an enemy, rendering it vulnerable to Damage.

abilities.name: Brimstone
abilities.desc: Uriel and his demons create a growing ring of flaming brimstone. Charge the ability by utilizing demon abilities. Damage inflicted increases with each consecutive hit.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Berserker.name: Valkyr
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Berserker.desc: Valkyr was modified into a highly motivated and fearsome killer. She is adept at dealing damage and surviving. Her battle cry strikes terror into all who hear it.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Berserker.passive: Valkyr accumulates Rage when hitting or killing enemies with melee weapons, increasing her Melee Damage up to X%. Taking fatal damage when the Rage meter is above X% consumes the meter, preventing death and granting Xs of invulnerability.

abilities.name: Rip Line
abilities.desc: Valkyr hurls forth a hook and pulls herself to whatever it hits. If it hits an enemy, nearby foes are pulled in as she unleashes a coordinated Melee attack.

abilities.name: Warcry
abilities.desc: Valkyr lets out a rallying cry that bolsters Armor and Attack Speed for allies while in Affinity Range.

abilities.name: Paralysis
abilities.desc: Unleash a damaging blast, slowing its victims while increasing their Melee Damage Vulnerability.

abilities.name: Hysteria
abilities.desc: Valkyr bares her deadly claws, unleashing devastating attacks that also heal her. Valkyr becomes immune to Status Effects and her Armor bonus from Warcry is multiplied while using the claws.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/ValkyrPrime.name: Valkyr Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/ValkyrPrime.desc: A proud fighter emerges unscarred by time or malice. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Trapper/Trapper.name: Vauban
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trapper/Trapper.desc: Vauban is the model of innovative technology. He deploys clever inventions to provide crowd control. His tenacity and focus make him formidable.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Trapper/Trapper.passive: Deal xX Damage to incapacitated enemies.

abilities.name: Tesla Nervos
abilities.desc: Deploy a roller drone that attaches itself to enemies and delivers bursts of arcing  Electricity Damage to anything in the immediate area.

abilities.name: Minelayer
abilities.desc:
Control the battlefield with masterful mines. Vauban's Tether-Flechette orb immobilizes and draws in enemies while launching deadly nails in all directions.

HOLD to launch a Vector-Overdrive pad that accelerates foes and allies alike in the pad's direction, increasing ally Movement Speed and Weapon Damage.

abilities.name: Photon Strike
abilities.desc: Drop a targeting beacon that calls in a devastating laser artillery strike. Deals doubled damage to enemies with Overguard.

abilities.name: Bastille
abilities.desc:
Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.

HOLD to collapse all Bastilles into a single damaging vortex.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/Volt.desc: Electricity flows through Volt. His attacks deal high damage. Enemies will be shocked.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/Volt.passive: Grounded movement generates an electrical charge building up X Damage per meter that is unleashed with the next attack.

abilities.name: Shock
abilities.desc: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Speed
abilities.desc: Embody an electric current. Volt and his allies receive a brief movement speed boost and a reload speed buff.

abilities.name: Electric Shield
abilities.desc:
Volt deploys an electric shield that blocks enemy fire and adds Electricity Damage to projectiles.
 
HOLD to equip the shield for mobile cover.

abilities.name: Discharge
abilities.desc: Volt discharges the electricity that courses through him. The shockwave paralyzes and damages nearby enemies. Enemies on the edge of the shockwave are stunned.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/VoltPrime.name: Volt Prime

/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/Werewolf.name: Voruna
/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/Werewolf.desc: Four beasts, one heart. Voruna's loyal wolf pack makes for a deadly combination of strength and stealth. Beware the monstrous howl that heralds fangs of vengeance.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/Werewolf.passive: Voruna never fights alone. In mission, hold Abilities to call upon each wolf's unique Passive power.

abilities.name: Shroud Of Dynar
abilities.desc:
(TAP) Dynar shrouds Voruna with invisibility and accelerates her speed. Invisibility ends when Voruna attacks. For a short time after invisibility ends, melee attacks have increased Critical Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance and inflict Slash Status Effects. Melee kill an enemy during this time to extend the melee buff once per cast.

(HOLD) Dynar guards Voruna, increasing her Parkour Velocity.

abilities.name: Fangs Of Raksh
abilities.desc:
(TAP) Raksh's fangs tear into your enemies. 5 random Status Effects are applied at 10 Stacks each on an enemy. On target's death, spread the Status Effects to other nearby enemies.

(HOLD) Raksh guards Voruna with Status Effect resistance.

abilities.name: Lycath's Hunt
abilities.desc:
(TAP) Lycath hunts to sustain the pack. Enemies killed by melee attacks drop health orbs and enemies killed by headshots drop energy orbs. Increase the duration of Lycath's hunt by killing enemies affected by 5 or more Status Effects.

(HOLD) Lycath guards Voruna with increased Heavy Attack efficiency.

abilities.name: Ulfrun's Descent
abilities.desc:
(TAP) Voruna drops to all fours and prepares 5 brutal charges that lock onto enemies. Ulfrun, the most powerful wolf, leads the attack as Voruna dashes toward her target. The pack deals increased damage to targets and nearby enemies that are inflicted by Status Effects. Lethal attacks double the damage of Voruna's remaining charges.

(HOLD) Ulfrun guards Voruna. If Voruna falls during this time, Ulfrun dies in her place.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/VorunaPrime.name: Voruna Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/VorunaPrime.desc: Splendor and ferocity reach their savage apex in Voruna Prime. Though exalted by Orokin gold, she is more feral than ever.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/Wisp.name: Wisp
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/Wisp.desc: Wisp floats between the material and the ethereal. She accesses multiple dimensions to support her allies. Her countenance is mysterious and enigmatic.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/Wisp.passive: Flowing between dimensions, Wisp becomes invisible to enemies while in the air.

abilities.name: Reservoirs
abilities.desc: Choose and summon a Reservoir filled with Motes that attach to and aid Wisp and her allies. Haste Mote grants increased movement and attack speed. Vitality Mote increases maximum health and heals over time. Shock Mote stuns nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Wil-O-Wisp
abilities.desc: Cast forward a spectral image of Wisp to confuse and distract enemies. Reactivate to travel to its position. Hold to have the image travel faster and teleport to its position on release.

abilities.name: Breach Surge
abilities.desc:
Open a dimensional breach to overwhelm nearby enemies and cause them to release aggressive Surge sparks when damaged.
Wisp may also target a Reservoir to teleport to it and double the range of the surge.

abilities.name: Sol Gate
abilities.desc: Open a portal to the sun to irradiate enemies with a devastating beam of pure solar plasma. Hold fire to double Damage at the cost of increased energy consumption. For the duration of an attack enemies damaged by Sol Gate are increasingly more vulnerable to it.

/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/MonkeyKing.name: Wukong
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/MonkeyKing.desc: The simian warrior is a mountain of strength. Wukong deals heavy damage and has high survivability. His quick trickster tactics are unforgettable.
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/MonkeyKing.passive: After taking fatal damage Wukong automatically uses one of his mastered survival techniques. These techniques can only be invoked three times per mission.

abilities.name: Celestial Twin
abilities.desc:
Shedding part of himself, Wukong creates a twin to fight by his side. Attack at range and the twin will melee, pull a blade and the twin will lay down covering fire.
Use again to command the twin to attack a target with increased damage.

abilities.name: Cloud Walker
abilities.desc: Evaporate into a cloud of mist and float through the battlefield, dazing any enemies encountered, while healing Wukong and his twin.

abilities.name: Defy
abilities.desc:
Wukong and his twin become invulnerable and defy enemies to attack. All damage is captured, stored, and dealt back in a single furious strike of Wukong's staff.
Bonus Armor is then granted relative to the damage captured.

abilities.name: Primal Fury
abilities.desc: Summon the iron staff and unleash fury.

abilities.name: Xata's Whisper
abilities.desc: Wield Void Damage for all attacks from equipped weapons when activated.

abilities.name: Grasp Of Lohk
abilities.desc: Void Tendrils steal weapons from nearby enemies to use as your own floating, auto-targeting armament. Damage output increases based on enemy level. The number of weapons grabbed also determines the damage multiplier for The Lost: Deny's Void beam.

abilities.desc: Cycle through a trio of lost Warframe powers. Accuse manifests a Void fissure to corrupt enemies into allies.
